svg.title: instruction-banner-and-four-subtask-cards-in-rounded-frame
svg.desc: light-blue outlined rounded frame with a two-line serif title, a light-blue rounded banner holding a four-line instruction and a 2x2 grid of dashed rounded sub-task cards, each with a yellow vertical Stage label rotated along its left edge, a one-line caption and a fan of three or four overlapped room photos (grey slots) | source: cvpr25-0058_fig1 (cvpr25-0058_fig1_p1_mixed.svg) | candidate wave1:instruction-banner-and-four-subtask-cards-in-rounded-frame | units: pt at print size | colours as drawn, recolour by role
